fieldHints.tpState: Shows whether the Community Market is available on the account
fieldHints.ktState: Status of the Steam red warning banner. God forbid you see anything here but OK 😈
fieldHints.steamAccountBalance: Steam balances are shown here😙. What else is there to say?
fieldHints.number: This is the number in the app. It cannot be changed. It is just a number to make work easier
fieldHints.steamAccountNickname: Steam nicknames (from the profile) are shown here
fieldHints.steamId: The account's SteamID64 (from the maFile). Search works by it too
fieldHints.proxyHost: Proxy hosts are shown here. This is the IP address part. For example: 123.123.123.123
fieldHints.proxyPort: Proxy ports are shown here. For example: 30013
fieldHints.proxyUsername: Logins of your proxies are shown here
fieldHints.proxyPassword: Passwords of your proxies are shown here
fieldHints.linkedSteamAccounts: Numbers of the accounts linked to this proxy. (Each account in the list will work through this proxy)
fieldHints.linkedProfiles: Numbers of the profiles linked to this proxy (Each profile in the list will work through this proxy)
